name: lytlnyblOS
description: lytlnyblOS (little nibble OS) is a small, from scratch 32-bit operating system that comes with a complete guide book to teach beginners practically about OS development.

paragraphs: lytlnyblOS (little nibble OS) is a small, from-scratch 32-bit operating system, built to teach beginners practically about OS development. It runs on a QEMU virtual machine. Built alongside The lytlnyblOS Book, a guide that walks through writing an OS from a 16-bit bootloader all the way through protected mode, interrupts, memory management, processes, a filesystem, userspace, and a working shell.
The code in this repo is the code taught in the book. Every part of it corresponds to something explained in the book; this is the whole point of the project.
Please use the website: 📖 red-mutt.github.io/lytlnyblOS for reading. Not the GitHub repository, for a better experience.
